Data:Leiter.connie.resigned.mission.auta.desc: 'It took me too long to leave the Bureau. Now this Institute is a new start… well, new starts always tarnish, but I've been careful about our allies. It isn't always easy, but I've had enough of compromises.'

Data:Leiter.connie.resigned.mission.reve.desc: 'The Bureau's done good, from time to time. I suppose even Calyptra had a point. But tyranny is tyranny. It's good to let the light in.'

Data:Leiter.connie.resigned.mission.ston.desc: 'This looting of god-bones… there is something grubby about it. But I knew that leaving the Bureau wouldn't really make things less complicated. We do what we must, not what we want. Using what's left of the gods-from-stone… it gives us more choice about 'must'. I am tired of compromises. But I do what I must.'

Data:Leiter.coquille.ally.chandler.json.desc: 'The New King! What a waste. If only he had not taken the field at Caen. The fire that burns in darkness has sunk low. But still it burns so prettily. I have learnt delightful things from Mihail, and I hope to learn much more.'

Data:Leiter.coquille.foe.nowhere.json.desc: 'When I agreed to join this Institute, I had no idea how much I would have to talk about Worms. It is distasteful.'

Data:Leiter.coquille.json.desc: Coquille's preferences are not reflected in the Lighthouse Institute's mission or position. Now and then, she is vocal in her petulance. But generally she still finds it all 'sufficiently diverting'.

Data:Leiter.coquille.mission.corrivality.desc: 'When I dwelt among the Hooded Princes, I was shielded from war. It was not very interesting. Now, the work is challenging sometimes, but I have made us rich: I have made us all rich.'

Data:Leiter.corso.ally.carapace.json.desc: 'Course, the Carapace Cross never uses books. Not the way we understand. But we can transcribe what they do use, now. Some good stuff in there.'

Data:Leiter.corso.foe.chandler.json.desc: 'Caen, eh? New King dies in battle, Chandler loses a royal piece, but also the side we don't like still gets spanked? Could hardly have worked out better. We can't keep counting on that kind of luck. Doing my best to keep us all informed.'

Data:Leiter.corso.json.desc: Corso can't find anyone to agree with his admittedly loosely held philosophical positions. Twice he's thrown a sulk and refused to attend meetings. Mostly he just gets on with it - and uses the Institute's connections to find unusual books after the wreck of the Wars.

Data:Leiter.corso.mission.revelation.jso.desc: 'You've no idea what a relief it is, not to wonder if it's the Bureau, every time I hear the bell jangle in the shop. That said, I've had to drop my prices for some of the really good stuff… but it's the mission that's important, of course. Wisdom wants to wander, and all that.'

Data:Leiter.corso.mission.stone.remember.desc: It's like we've opened the door into another country. It's like a wind of stone and heather. I think even the sun's a little redder. Know what? I like it.'

Data:Leiter.dagmar.ally.carapace.json.desc: 'Popped over to Miah, see how the Carabees are getting on in that garden. Not bees. Other things, Motten, you know. Getting on pretty well. Little too well, honestly. Still, rather them than Worms, what?'

Data:Leiter.dagmar.ally.ys.json.desc:
'Still haven't been to Ys.

Going to, though. One day.

Trade mission, sort of thing…'

Data:Leiter.dagmar.foe.chandler.json.desc: 'Shame to lose the New King at Caen like that. Course he was a bit chandly, but nice feller, good breedin', not many kings prepared to die in battle these days? Makin' it a bit easier now, though, pinchin' the wick, sort of thing. Plenty of wicks need pinching!'

Data:Leiter.dagmar.foe.nowhere.json.desc: 'Well look if I'm goin' to spend my money, I can't think of a better use for it than crushing Worms. And if I'm goin' to spend the Institute's money, rather that than my money! So all comin' up roses, sort of thing.'

Data:Leiter.dagmar.foe.ys.json.desc: 'Oh all very polite, these Ysien, clean as good dentistry, sharp as a button, but you let 'em get up close, and snap! Like getting your soul shut in a door. Brr. Well, we're wise to 'em now, aren't we?'

Data:Leiter.dagmar.json.desc: Dagmar doesn't have much interest in the Institute's goals, though apparently it's a useful tax dodge. She did manage to get meetings held at her estate, until she started asking for contributions to fix the roof.

Data:Leiter.dagmar.mission.autarchy.json.desc: 'Take our allies where we can find 'em, always said that, didn't I? Good thing too now with all these uncountable Hours. Uncounted? Uncontested? Can't find so many of the beggars, that's what I mean, none of this pokin' round the Mansus and bumpin' into something that'd burn your eyebrows up.'

Data:Leiter.dagmar.mission.peace.json.desc: 'Peace in short supply these days, what? Dishing it out where I can. Charitable activities. Had to sell the old, you know, estate. Roof was comin' off anyway. Charitable activities.'

Data:Leiter.dagmar.mission.revelation.js.desc: 'Revelation! Wish I could see the Madrugad's face. Scratch that, never said that, silly idea, blast me to ash, no doubt about it. Still though. See her face!'

Data:Leiter.dagmar.mission.secrecy.json.desc: 'Awfy grateful to Libsy for not running to Oriflamme's about, you know. Awfy grateful. And if Libsy can keep a secret, so can old Daymare. Awfy secret.'

Data:Leiter.douglas.foe.carapace.json.desc: 'I still have nightmares about that business in the Black Forest… I've been tracking down what's left of Liselotte's patients. For the surgery. Nasty. But better than the alternative.'

Data:Leiter.douglas.foe.nowhere.json.desc: 'Terrible things in the world today. Plenty of 'em. But the Worms are the worst. We're hoiking them out, one by one, though. And did you hear? They can't breed inside people any more. The world's changed, and not always in the worst way…'

Data:Leiter.douglas.foe.ys.json.desc: 'We found an Ysien Insidiate in Vauxhall last week. Swam all the way up the Thames. She was looking round the National Gallery when we took her in. Know what she said? 'Ys will look like this, one day.' Can't get it out of me head.'

Data:Leiter.douglas.json.desc: Douglas is disappointed about the Institute's direction, but he carries out his duties with weary doggedness.

Data:Leiter.douglas.mission.secrecy.json.desc: 'The Duties endure. I remember when I got into all this. Still thought I'd retire, some day, back then. Beginning to be glad I didn't.'

Data:Leiter.echidna.persistent.ally.ys.j.desc: 'I have sent one of my children to Ys, as a hostage. They have sent one of their daughters. I keep her under glass. We are all of us the greatest friends.'

Data:Leiter.echidna.persistent.foe.devou.desc: 'I see how they look at me. A true Ligeian does not care how she is looked at. They keep me close because they do not trust me. They are wise. We all benefit thereby. One day, it will end, and my children will feast. Until then, I am loyal to my duty.'

Data:Leiter.echidna.persistent.foe.nowhe.desc: 'I will not risk my children against the Worms. But I have been known to take the field in person, now and then.'

Data:Leiter.echidna.persistent.json.desc: Echidna is silent in every meeting. It is impossible to be certain what she actually thinks of the Institute. Other members have begun to talk about whether a Secretary Persistent is actually necessary at all… but they don't talk about it in Echidna's presence.

Data:Leiter.echidna.persistent.mission.c.desc: 'I will admit this: I have not always been a good mother. But for a great many years, my first care has been for my children. I count the Institute among my children now. And after a battle, my children always eat well.'

Data:Leiter.echidna.persistent.mission.s.desc: 'I will admit this: I have not always been a good mother. But for a great many years, my first care has been for my children. I shade them from the burning light of the sun; I keep them from the eyes of hunters. I count the Institute among my children now.'

'I will admit this: I have not always been a good mother. But for a great many years, my first care has been for my children. I count the Institute among my children now. For too long, the succulence of the gods-from-Stone has gone untasted. Now, all my children are feasting. I am pleased.'

Data:Leiter.ehsan.ally.carapace.json.desc: 'All of us change, don't we? In my skaptodon days, I feared change as I longed for it, and now I am only glad of it. Many fear and long for the Cross-change, and I have helped to show them the way.'

Data:Leiter.ehsan.foe.carapace.json.desc: 'All of us change, don't we? In my skaptodon days, I feared change as I longed for it. So I understand the temptation of the Cross-change, and so, when my skills are called on, I can end that temptation.'

Data:Leiter.ehsan.foe.nowhere.json.desc: 'I have been called to attend several cases of infestation by Worms, this year alone. I didn't enjoy it. But something has changed: they cannot develop as they did, inside a human skin; they cannot make more of their own. I wonder: is it something we did? Or something in the Sun?'

Data:Leiter.ehsan.json.desc: Ehsan's ideals don't have much in common with the ideals of the Institute; but he remembers the days of the Curia, the days when Hush House was a place of refuge and healing; he remembers the lights on the water, the laughter from the servants' quarters; he knows those days will never come again; but he keeps his faith.

Data:Leiter.ehsan.mission.secrecy.json.desc: 'I was too trusting, too long. I am a healer first, but a healer must also be a surgeon. I keep my knife sharp, for the Institute, and for Calyptra's remembered shadow.'

Data:Leiter.ehsan.mission.stone.remember.desc: 'Perhaps I had become too suspicious; too grudging with my skills. I have learnt to be generous again, here at the Institute, and in the world. It is not only mortals I heal, now.'
